dismissible.description: false for a critical banner, or one published as not dismissible: it stays until it ends.

id.description: The banner's ID: dismiss it with this.

link.description: Where it leads: a path in the web app or an https address; absent for none.

examples: The office is closed on 3 November; bills due that day are paid on 4 November.

scope.description: organisation: published by its Owner or Administrator; installation: by a Super admin, to everyone.

severity.description: info and warning are announced politely (role=status), critical at once (role=alert).
